items.title: AGIBOT introduces Worken to measure robot productivity at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026
items.summary: AGIBOT unveiled its AHA3 integrated platform, GO-3 Preview, and WITA-Omni 1.0 model, as well as the G2 Max robot and Link-U OS 1.0 framework.The post AGIBOT introduces Worken to measure robot productivity at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026 appeared first on The Robot Report.
